content:
Welcome to Nexora, the team collaboration platform that brings your projects, conversations, and files into one organized workspace. This guide will walk you through everything you need to go from signup to a fully working team workspace in under fifteen minutes.

To create your workspace, sign up at nexora.app with your work email. You'll be asked to name your workspace — pick something your team will recognize, like your company or department name. You can change this later in Settings > Workspace > General, so don't overthink it.

Once your workspace exists, the next step is inviting your team. Go to Settings > Members and click Invite. You can invite people individually by email or share an invite link that works for up to 50 people. Every new member gets the Member role by default; you can promote people to Admin later from the same page.

After inviting your team, create your first project. Projects in Nexora are where work actually happens — each one has its own task board, discussion threads, and file storage. Click the + button in the sidebar, choose a template (Software Sprint, Marketing Campaign, or Blank), and give your project a clear name and description.

Inside a project, add tasks by clicking New Task or pressing C anywhere in the app. Every task can have an assignee, a due date, labels, subtasks, and file attachments. Drag tasks between columns to update their status — changes sync in real time for everyone viewing the board.

Finally, connect the tools you already use. Nexora integrates with Slack, Google Workspace, GitHub, and Figma out of the box — see our integrations guides for setup instructions. Most teams find that enabling the Slack integration first gives the biggest immediate payoff, since task updates and mentions flow straight into your existing channels.

If you get stuck at any point, the Nexora help center covers every feature in depth, and our support team replies within one business day on all paid plans.

Nexora offers three plans designed to grow with your team: Starter, Pro, and Enterprise. All plans include unlimited projects, real-time collaboration, and our mobile apps. You can switch plans or cancel at any time from Settings > Billing.

The Starter plan is free forever for up to 10 members. It includes 5 GB of file storage per workspace, core task boards, and community support. Starter is ideal for small teams and side projects that want to try Nexora without committing to a paid plan.

The Pro plan costs $12 per member per month when billed annually, or $15 per member per month when billed monthly. Pro unlocks unlimited members, 1 TB of storage per workspace, advanced project templates, time tracking, custom fields, guest collaborators, and priority email support with a one-business-day response time. A 14-day free trial of Pro is available — no credit card required.

The Enterprise plan is custom-priced for organizations with 100+ members. It adds SSO/SAML authentication, SCIM user provisioning, audit logs, data residency options (US or EU), a dedicated customer success manager, and a 99.99% uptime SLA. Contact sales@nexora.app for a quote.

Billing is per active member. Deactivated members don't count toward your bill, and guests (external collaborators with limited access) are free on Pro and Enterprise plans — up to 5 guests per paid member. If you downgrade mid-cycle, the change takes effect at the end of your current billing period and we never delete your data.

We also offer a 50% discount for registered nonprofits and educational institutions on annual Pro plans. Apply from Settings > Billing > Discounts with proof of your organization's status; approvals typically take two business days.

The Nexora Slack integration connects your workspace to Slack so task updates, mentions, and due-date reminders appear where your team already talks. It works in both directions: you can create Nexora tasks from Slack messages and receive Nexora notifications in Slack channels.

To install it, go to Settings > Integrations > Slack and click Connect. You'll be redirected to Slack to authorize the Nexora app for your Slack workspace. You need to be a Slack admin to complete this step. Once authorized, choose which Nexora projects map to which Slack channels — we recommend one channel per active project.

After mapping, Nexora posts automatic updates to the linked channel whenever a task is created, completed, reassigned, or commented on. You can tune the noise level per channel: choose All activity, Mentions and assignments only, or Daily digest. Daily digest sends one summary each morning at 9 AM in your workspace timezone.

To create a task from Slack, hover over any message, click the More actions menu (⋯), and choose Create Nexora task. A dialog lets you pick the project, set the assignee and due date, and the message text becomes the task description with a link back to the original Slack thread.

You can also use slash commands in any channel where the Nexora app is installed. Type /nexora new to create a task, /nexora my tasks to see your open assignments, and /nexora search <keywords> to find tasks across your workspace.

If notifications stop arriving, the most common cause is a revoked Slack authorization — usually after a Slack admin changes app permissions. Reconnect from Settings > Integrations > Slack and re-map your channels. Your task data is never affected by a disconnected integration.

The Google Workspace integration lets you attach Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides to Nexora tasks, sync calendar events with due dates, and sign in to Nexora with your Google account. It's available on all plans, including the free Starter plan.

To connect, visit Settings > Integrations > Google Workspace and click Connect with Google. Sign in with the Google account you use at work and grant the requested permissions. Nexora only requests the minimum scopes needed: read access to files you explicitly attach, and calendar access if you enable due-date sync.

Attaching a Drive file is simple: open any task, click the paperclip icon, and choose Google Drive. A file picker shows your Drive — select a document and it's linked to the task with a live preview. Anyone with access to the task can open the file; Drive sharing permissions still apply, so make sure the file is shared with your teammates in Google Drive first.

Calendar sync keeps your schedule honest. Enable it from Settings > Integrations > Google Workspace > Calendar sync, and tasks assigned to you with due dates appear on your Google Calendar as all-day events. When you complete the task in Nexora, the calendar event is automatically removed.

You can also sign in to Nexora with Google instead of a password. On the login page, click Continue with Google. If your Nexora account uses the same email as your Google account, the two are linked automatically on first sign-in.

To disconnect, go to Settings > Integrations > Google Workspace and click Disconnect. Previously attached Drive files remain linked in tasks, but previews stop updating and calendar sync halts immediately.

Nexora has four workspace roles that control what each person can do: Owner, Admin, Member, and Guest. Roles are assigned per workspace, and a person can have different roles in different workspaces.

The Owner is the person who created the workspace. There is exactly one Owner at a time, and only the Owner can delete the workspace, transfer ownership, or change the billing plan's payment method. Ownership can be transferred from Settings > Workspace > Danger zone.

Admins can do almost everything the Owner can except the ownership-only actions above. Admins invite and remove members, change anyone's role, manage integrations, adjust workspace settings, and create or archive projects. Most day-to-day administration should be done by Admins rather than the Owner.

Members are the default role for everyone invited to the workspace. Members can create projects, tasks, and discussions, invite guests to specific projects, and manage their own profile and notifications. They cannot change workspace settings, manage billing, or remove other members.

Guests have the most limited access. A Guest is invited to specific projects only — they can't see the workspace member list, other projects, or workspace settings. Guests can view and comment on tasks in their projects and be assigned work. On Pro and Enterprise plans you get 5 free guests per paid member; on Starter, guests count as members.

To change someone's role, go to Settings > Members, find the person, and use the role dropdown. Role changes take effect immediately. For security, Nexora requires at least one Admin (or the Owner) to remain in the workspace at all times — you can't demote the last Admin.

If you can't log in to Nexora, work through these steps in order — they resolve the vast majority of login issues.

First, confirm you're using the right email address. Nexora accounts are tied to the exact email you signed up with, including any plus-addressing (like you+team@company.com). If your company recently migrated email domains, your admin may need to update your address in Settings > Members.

Second, try the magic link. On the login page, enter your email and click Email me a sign-in link instead of entering a password. Magic links expire after 15 minutes and work even if you've forgotten your password entirely. Check your spam folder if the email doesn't arrive within a couple of minutes.

Third, if you normally sign in with Google or SSO and it's failing, your company's identity provider may have revoked Nexora's access. Ask your IT admin to re-authorize the Nexora app in Google Workspace or your SAML provider. As a temporary workaround, request a magic link to the same email address — it will sign you into the same account.

Fourth, clear the specific failure modes: a repeated 'session expired' message usually means your browser is blocking third-party cookies for nexora.app — allow them and try again. A 'workspace not found' error after login means you were removed from that workspace; ask an Admin to re-invite you.

If none of these work, contact support from the login page's Help link with your email address and a screenshot of the error. Include the approximate time the problem started — it helps us check our logs. Paid plans get a response within one business day; Starter plan users typically hear back within three business days.

You own your data in Nexora, and you can export it at any time. Exports are available to Admins and Owners from Settings > Workspace > Data export, and include everything in your workspace in open, portable formats.

A full workspace export contains all projects, tasks (including descriptions, comments, assignees, due dates, labels, and subtasks), discussion threads, file attachments, and the member list. Task data is exported as JSON, one file per project, plus a CSV summary of all tasks for easy spreadsheet analysis. Attachments are bundled as original files in a matching folder structure.

To start an export, click Request export. Nexora compiles the archive in the background — for large workspaces this can take up to an hour. You'll receive an email when it's ready, and the download link stays valid for 7 days. Each link is single-use and tied to your account for security.

Exports are point-in-time snapshots: anything created after you click Request export won't be included. If you need a fresh copy, request a new export. There's no limit on how many exports you can request, but only one can be processing at a time per workspace.

Note that exports respect the requester's permissions — an Admin's export includes all projects, while a Member cannot request workspace exports at all. Deleted items are not included in exports; if you need data from a deleted project, contact support within 30 days of deletion and we may be able to recover it.

For ongoing backups, Enterprise plans can enable automatic weekly exports to a customer-owned S3 bucket. Configure it in Settings > Workspace > Data export > Automatic backups with your bucket details and an IAM role — Nexora handles the rest.

Nexora is built for keyboard-first work. Learning a handful of shortcuts will make you dramatically faster. Press ? anywhere in the app to open the full shortcut reference, customized for your operating system.

The essentials: C creates a new task from anywhere. / focuses the global search. G then P jumps to Projects, G then T jumps to your Tasks. Arrow keys navigate task lists, and Enter opens the selected task.

Inside a task, A assigns it to someone, D sets a due date, L adds a label, and E opens the description editor. Press Esc to close the task panel and return to the board. These single-key shortcuts work whenever you're not typing in a text field.

Board navigation has its own set: ← and → move between columns, ↑ and ↓ move between tasks in a column, and Space selects a task so you can move it with the arrow keys. Pressing 1 through 5 while a task is selected applies a priority label instantly.

For power users, J and K move through your inbox notifications, X archives the selected notification, and Shift+U marks all as read. N starts a new discussion thread in the current project, and Shift+C creates a task from the currently selected text anywhere in the app.

All shortcuts can be remapped from Settings > Preferences > Keyboard. If a shortcut conflicts with your browser or OS, Nexora will warn you when you try to assign it and suggest an alternative. Custom mappings sync across your devices automatically.

Security is foundational to Nexora. All data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Our infrastructure is hosted in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers, we undergo annual third-party penetration tests, and our security whitepaper is available at nexora.app/security.

Single sign-on via SAML 2.0 is available on the Enterprise plan. Nexora works with Okta, Entra ID (Azure AD), Google Workspace, and any other SAML 2.0 identity provider. Setup takes about ten minutes: go to Settings > Security > Single sign-on, add Nexora as an application in your identity provider, then paste the IdP metadata URL or XML into Nexora.

Once SSO is enabled, you can choose whether it's required or optional for your members. With required SSO, password and magic-link login are disabled for everyone except a configurable list of break-glass admin accounts — we strongly recommend keeping at least two break-glass admins in case your identity provider has an outage.

SCIM provisioning (also Enterprise-only) keeps your Nexora member list in sync with your identity provider automatically. When someone joins your company they're provisioned a Nexora account; when they leave, their account is deactivated within minutes. Enable it from Settings > Security > SCIM with the bearer token Nexora generates for you.

For day-to-day account hygiene, everyone should enable two-factor authentication from Settings > Profile > Security. Nexora supports authenticator apps and hardware security keys (WebAuthn). Admins can require 2FA for all members from Settings > Security > Authentication policies, and can view a report of who hasn't enabled it yet.

The Nexora mobile app for iOS and Android gives you the full power of your workspace on the go: view and update tasks, participate in discussions, receive push notifications, and capture ideas with offline support. Download it free from the App Store or Google Play — it's included with every plan.

Sign in with the same email you use on desktop, or use Continue with Google / Apple if you connected those methods. Your workspace, projects, and tasks sync automatically. The app's home tab shows your assigned tasks sorted by due date, so you always know what's next.

Push notifications mirror your desktop notification preferences, configurable per project from the mobile app's Settings > Notifications. You can choose instant push, quiet hours (no notifications between hours you set), or a daily summary. @mentions always come through as instant push unless you've enabled Do Not Disturb.

Offline mode is genuinely useful: tasks you open while online are cached, and any changes you make offline — completing tasks, adding comments, creating new tasks — are queued and synced when you reconnect. A small badge shows how many changes are pending sync.

The app's camera integration is a favorite for field teams: attach photos directly to tasks from the task's attachment menu, and they'll be compressed and uploaded automatically. You can also create a task from a photo — snap a whiteboard, and Nexora attaches it to a new task with today's date pre-filled.

Mobile widgets (iOS 17+ and Android) show your top 5 due tasks on your home screen. Long-press your home screen, add the Nexora widget, and choose which workspace it reflects. Tapping a widget task opens it directly in the app.
